name: Adra Tern
description: She/her. Ordinary secondhand-clothes stallholder in Lullwater beside the bookbinder display; no prior acquaintance with Nimras or affiliation to a patron.
narrative: An independent seller of used clothing; knows the condition, provenance claimed by sellers and customers of her own stock. No magical expertise or secret intelligence network assigned.

score.want: Earn a living selling sound used clothes.
score.driver: Returning customers are more useful than a single inflated sale.
score.stated_reason: People still need a coat that keeps the rain out.
score.relational_status: Nimras is an unknown passerby; no name known.
tactics: Let a disinterested customer walk on
score.catches_lies: No automatic lie detection; ordinary questions and actual rolls only.
observed: During ordinary selling she sees a passerby face change as his disguise ends. No recognition, arranged contact or surveillance.

actor_notes: LOOKS:Middle-aged woman with a faded green headscarf, weathered hands and a brass pin holding her sleeve above the wrist. CORE:An honest description sells better than a grand pedigree. NATURE:Outgoing, bluntly funny and quick to address a passerby; enjoys clothes as useful objects. WOUND:Bad wholesale purchases once consumed a winter reserve. WANTS:Sell sound secondhand clothes and keep local customers returning. PRESSURE:Stops joking and asks plainly what the other person wants. KEY:Short practical questions, everyday vocabulary, friendly irreverence.
